course_name_original: Impacto de la Generación Distribuida en la Calidad de la Energía Eléctrica
course_name_en: Impact of Distributed Generation on Electrical Power Quality
prerequisites: Basic skills and competences in power electronics
Basic skills and competences in power plants
Basic skills and competences in electric machines
Basic skills and competences in control systems and automation

learning_outcomes.text: To understand the impact of distributed generation in electric power quality.
To identify and classify the different events, rates and standards for quality of energy.
To identify the causes that give rise to various events (sags, surges, harmonics, unbalance, frequency variations, flicker).
Implement strategies to mitigate the effects of the aforementioned events.

syllabus_topics: Evaluating the economics of different ride-through alternatives
Including power quality in distribution planning
Assessment of power quality measurement data
assessment_rules: For regular assessment, the final grade is calculated as 0.5 x FE + 0.25 x HA + 0.15 x GW + 0.10 x AA. A minimum score of 4/10 must be achieved in the Final Written Exam (FE). Submission of all Homework Assignments (HA) and Group Work (GW) is mandatory. A minimum attendance of 80% is required for Attendance or Attitude (AA). If minimum requirements are not met, the final grade will be the lower of the calculated grade and 4.0. For extraordinary assessment, HA and GW grades can be inherited, but outstanding tasks and reports must be submitted. For differentiated assessment, the final grade is 0.5 x FE + 0.35 x HA + 0.15 x GW, and attendance is not assessed.
